pageHeading: Non-Medical Home Care Services Across North Carolina
pageIntro: We provide non-medical in-home senior care and companion care throughout our service area, including Winston-Salem, helping your loved one stay safe, comfortable, and independent at home.

services.title: Companion Care & Safety Sitting
services.tagline: So they're never alone or at risk.
services.description: Our companion care pairs your loved one with a caregiver who provides companionship and supervision, reducing fall risk and isolation for seniors living alone.

services.title: Rehab Support (PT/OT Exercises)
services.tagline: Keeping them on track between appointments.
services.description: We help clients stay consistent with physical and occupational therapy exercises prescribed by their care team, supporting recovery between scheduled appointments.

services.title: Medication Reminders
services.description: Caregivers provide timely reminders to take medication as prescribed, helping prevent missed or duplicate doses.

services.title: Meal Prep, Hydration & Feeding Help
services.description: From preparing meals to encouraging regular hydration and assisting with feeding when needed, we help ensure proper nutrition every day.

services.title: Daily Preparation
services.description: Respectful, dignified assistance with dressing and daily hygiene routines.

services.title: Errands
services.tagline: From pharmacy runs to grocery store.
services.description: Caregivers handle pharmacy pickups, grocery runs, and other errands so your loved one's essentials are always covered.

services.title: Light Housekeeping & Home Comfort Care
services.tagline: A clean, safe space for recovery.
services.description: Light housekeeping to keep the home clean, safe, and comfortable, supporting a healthy recovery and living environment.

ctaText: Call us and we'll help you figure out the right plan of support.
